144.seo_title_en: Bespoke office and workspace furniture — Artes

testi.Progettiamo, produciamo e realizziamo am: We design, craft and fit out workspaces for companies, professional practices, banks, schools, healthcare facilities and public bodies. From space planning and bespoke fabrication to supply and installation, we manage every phase of the project.

testi.La pianificazione delle attività di forn: Delivery and installation schedules are structured around your operational requirements and the specifics of the site, with full organisational flexibility.
testi.Operiamo in diversi ambiti professionali: We work across corporate, professional and institutional environments, tailoring every furnishing solution to the specific functions and character of the space.
testi.<span>Tipologie</span> Uffici aziendali,: Spaces Corporate offices, co-working spaces, call centres, software houses, law firms, notaries, accountancy practices, architecture, engineering and design studios, marketing and communications agencies
testi.<span>Tipologie</span> Banche, assicuraz: Spaces Banks, insurance offices, financial institutions, tax and advisory centres, service centres, vehicle licensing agencies
testi.<span>Tipologie</span> Scuole, universit: Spaces Schools, universities, academies, training centres, libraries, playrooms, driving schools
testi.<span>Tipologie</span> Strutture sanitar: Spaces Healthcare facilities, outpatient clinics, medical practices, dental surgeries, private clinics, physiotherapy and rehabilitation centres, diagnostic centres, testing laboratories
testi.<span>Tipologie</span> Enti pubblici, am: Spaces Public bodies, local and national government offices, armed forces and defence, institutional buildings, multi-purpose civic centres
testi.<strong>Hai un ambiente di lavoro da rea: Fitting out or refurbishing a workspace? From a single supply to a complete headquarters, we guide companies and professionals in choosing and building the right furnishing solutions.
testi.Rilievi, analisi delle esigenze e svilup: Site surveys, needs analysis and layout planning for workstations, meeting rooms, operational areas and common spaces. We produce 2D drawings, 3D models and renders through to technical shop drawings.
testi.Soluzioni per migliorare il comfort acus: Solutions engineered to improve acoustic comfort and confidentiality at work: sound-absorbing panels, partition walls, glazed partitions, phone booths and private meeting rooms.
testi.Realizziamo nella nostra falegnameria re: In our joinery workshop we craft reception desks, wall panelling, storage walls, boardroom tables and custom units, combining bespoke joinery with partner-brand office systems.
testi.Coordiniamo approvvigionamenti, logistic: We coordinate procurement, logistics, deliveries and fitting, scheduling work around your operational needs and site conditions.
testi.Operiamo sul Mercato elettronico della P: We are accredited on Italy's Electronic Public Procurement Marketplace (MePA) and manage technical and administrative documentation, specifications and tender procedures for public institutions.
testi.Selezioniamo prodotti corredati dalla do: We specify products backed by full technical documentation, prioritising solutions compliant with Italy's Minimum Environmental Criteria (CAM) and, for upholstered furniture, Class 1IM fire-resistance certification where required.
testi.Ogni commessa racconta il nostro modo di: Every commission reflects how we design, craft and deliver working environments. Featured projects in this sector include Ruffolo Group, Costruzioni Imbrogno, BCC di Tarsia, Il Quotidiano, Ingrediente School and Arpacal. View all projects.

testi.Gestiamo forniture e realizzazioni di di: We deliver projects of varying scale and complexity, coordinating design, manufacturing, procurement and installation.
testi.Forniture integrate di arredi standard e: Integrated supplies of standard and bespoke furniture
testi.Potete arredare l'ufficio senza interrom: Can you furnish our office without interrupting daily operations?
testi.Sì. Organizziamo consegne e installazion: Yes. We plan deliveries and installations in coordinated phases, agreeing schedules and site procedures with you to keep disruption to daily work to a minimum.
testi.Lavorate con il progetto del nostro arch: Do you work alongside our appointed architect?
testi.Sì. Possiamo partire dal progetto del vo: Yes. We can work directly from your architect's or consultant's drawings, handling technical engineering, fabrication and installation. Alternatively, we can design the furniture ourselves in close coordination with your designer.
testi.Fornite anche enti pubblici e scuole?: Do you also supply public bodies and schools?
testi.Sì. Siamo abilitati al Mercato elettroni: Yes. We are accredited on the Electronic Public Procurement Marketplace (MePA) and supply public authorities, schools, universities and institutions, handling both the fit-out and all required technical and administrative documentation.

testi.Sì. Grazie alla nostra falegnameria inte: Yes. Through our in-house joinery workshop we manufacture bespoke pieces and integrate them seamlessly with partner-brand systems, tailored to your functional brief, room dimensions and architectural concept.

testi.Sì. Seguiamo lo sviluppo degli arredi da: Yes. We develop furniture from initial design layouts right through to production shop drawings. We can run the entire process in-house or take an existing architectural scheme and engineer every individual component.

149.seo_title_en: Bespoke furniture and joinery workshop — Artes
149.seo_description_en: In-house joinery workshop since 1985 and a qualified partner network for metalwork, stone, glass and upholstery: how ARTES crafts non-standard contract furniture to drawing.

testi.Arredo su misura — falegnameria e rete d: Bespoke furniture — in-house joinery and partner network
testi.Produrre su misura non significa produrr: Bespoke production does not mean improvised handwork. It means bringing industrial repeatability into the joinery workshop and dedicating skilled craft to the details that truly cannot be standardised.
testi.Un banco bar che segue il flusso del ser: A bar counter shaped around service flow, a reception desk set inside a historic hall, or a hotel room package produced in series: some pieces simply do not exist in any catalogue. That is what our joinery workshop — operating since 1985 — is built for.
testi.Ogni arredo su misura nasce da un riliev: Every custom piece begins with an on-site measured survey and detailed shop drawings. Drawings are translated into bills of materials and CNC machine programmes, followed by precision machining and hand finishing. Where required, complex assemblies are pre-fitted in our workshop before delivery to eliminate surprises on site.
testi.Su misura non significa solo pezzo unico: Bespoke does not only mean one-off pieces. We also produce repeatable batches for hotels, retail chains and multi-workstation offices to the same quality standard across the entire delivery. When metalwork, stone, glass or upholstery are required, we coordinate vetted specialist workshops within the same contract.
testi.Il legno lo lavoriamo nella nostra faleg: We machine and finish timber in our own joinery workshop, active since 1985. Metalwork, stone, glass and upholstery are produced by a network of vetted partners working strictly from our shop drawings, never from generic brochures.
testi.Il cuore della produzione. Banconi, bois: The heart of our production. Counters, wall panelling, reception desks, headboards, built-in wardrobes and fixed joinery are made in our workshop to measured site dimensions. CNC edge-banding, routing and drilling are followed by hand assembly and finishing, piece by piece.
testi.Arredi fissi e mobili su disegno, anche: Fixed and loose furniture built to drawing, including one-offs
testi.Strutture portanti, telai, gambe e profi: Load-bearing frames, legs, brackets and profiles fabricated to our shop drawings and fitted together with the joinery.
testi.Top, banconi, rivestimenti e vetrate. La: Worktops, counter tops, stone cladding and glazing. Installation is coordinated with joinery fitting to avoid double handling.
testi.Sedute, divani, panche continue e boiser: Seating, sofas, continuous banquettes and shaped upholstered wall panels for hospitality and dining.
testi.Ogni commessa entra in falegnameria già: Every commission enters the workshop fully engineered. The architect's drawing becomes a cutting list, CNC programme and installation sequence before the first board is cut.
testi.L'esecutivo diventa distinta materiali e: Shop drawings become a bill of materials and assembly diagram.
testi.Materiali e dettagli approvati dal proge: Materials and details signed off by the designer before cutting.
testi.Taglio, bordatura e foratura a controllo: CNC cutting, edge-banding and precision boring.
testi.Premontaggio in laboratorio, verifica qu: Workshop dry-fit, dimensional verification and batch packing.
testi.Come si inserisce nel processo contract: How this fits into the contract process
testi.Ambienti storici, pareti fuori squadra,: Historic buildings, out-of-square walls, irregular ceiling heights. Every unit is built to real measured dimensions rather than forcing the nearest catalogue module.
testi.Vani scala stretti, ascensori piccoli, a: Narrow staircases, compact lifts, tight doorways. Large pieces are engineered in knock-down sections with concealed joints built for clean on-site assembly.
testi.Passaggi elettrici, dati, illuminazione: Power, data, integrated lighting and concealed cable channels planned at drawing stage and coordinated with MEP trades.
testi.Nessuno: si produce anche il pezzo unico: None — we also craft single one-off pieces
testi.Fisiche, approvate prima dell'avvio prod: Physical samples approved prior to production
testi.Reazione al fuoco e requisiti contract s: Fire-reaction ratings and contract compliance per specification
testi.Distinta materiali per ogni commessa: Full bill of materials recorded for every project
testi.Non tutto conviene farlo in casa. Per me: Not every trade should be kept in-house. For metalwork, stone, glass and upholstery we collaborate with vetted specialist workshops working to our shop drawings and specifications — while full coordination and single-point responsibility stay with us.
testi.Il committente si affida a un unico refe: Clients deal with a single project manager coordinating our joinery workshop and specialist partners through to handover.
testi.Requisiti tecnici e cronoprogramma della: Technical standards and project milestones are shared across our workshop and every partner trade.

150.seo_title_en: Contract — ARTES end-to-end service from survey to handover
150.seo_description_en: Design, production, supply and installation of contract furniture with a single point of contact: the six phases of the ARTES method, from briefing to after-sales.

testi.Non forniamo solo arredi: coordiniamo l': We do not simply supply furniture: we coordinate the entire fit-out commission from initial briefing to handover of the completed spaces through a single point of contact. Each phase has defined deliverables and a shared schedule.
testi.L'arredo contract è un approccio integra: Contract furnishing is an integrated approach to fitting out commercial and institutional spaces. A single partner coordinates design, fabrication, procurement and installation, taking full accountability for the delivery.
testi.Invece di gestire autonomamente progetti: Instead of managing designers, makers, suppliers and fitters separately, the client works with one partner who aligns every discipline through to handover of the finished interiors.
testi.Partiamo dal rilievo degli spazi e svilu: We start with a measured site survey and develop the furniture scheme, collaborating closely with your appointed architectural studio where present. We craft bespoke joinery in-house, coordinate partner-brand supplies and sequence deliveries and installation around site trades.
testi.Il vantaggio è semplice: un unico refere: The advantage is straightforward: one dedicated contact accountable for schedule, cost and finish quality, from the first measurement to after-sales care. Our sector pages show how we apply the same method to offices, retail stores, bars and restaurants, food stores and hotels.
testi.Accompagniamo il cliente dall'analisi de: We guide clients from initial briefing to handover of the furnished spaces, aligning design, production and technical trades.
testi.Ascoltiamo il cliente, approfondiamo gli: We listen carefully, clarify project goals and define functional, aesthetic and budgetary parameters.
testi.Un quadro chiaro di esigenze e obiettivi: A clear brief of requirements and objectives
testi.Analizziamo gli spazi, rileviamo le dime: We inspect the premises, record exact dimensions and verify architectural and MEP constraints.
testi.Sviluppiamo layout, viste 3D e render, i: We prepare layouts, 3D views and renders, specify materials, finishes and products, and issue an itemised proposal combining bespoke joinery and partner-brand supplies.
testi.Ingegnerizziamo e realizziamo gli arredi: We engineer and fabricate custom pieces in our joinery workshop while coordinating partner-brand orders so every element integrates seamlessly.
testi.Pianifichiamo le consegne, coordiniamo l: We plan deliveries, supervise fitting teams and inspect every installed item through to formal sign-off.
testi.Restiamo al fianco del cliente anche dop: We stay alongside our clients after handover with ongoing support, warranty administration and maintenance assistance.
testi.Un referente per l'assistenza nel tempo: A dedicated contact for ongoing support
testi.Le fasi possono sovrapporsi: il cronopro: Phases may overlap: the final programme is tailored to the specifics of each commission and on-site conditions.

151.seo_description_en: Since 1975 we have designed, crafted and installed bespoke contract furniture in Calabria and across Italy. A single point of contact from site survey to after-sales.

testi.Artes nasce nel 1975 come piccola impres: Artes was founded in 1975 as a small artisanal workshop specialising in textiles and furnishing accessories. Since 1985 it has run its own joinery workshop, and since 1988 it has worked in contract interiors. Today, with fifty years of experience, it coordinates design, production, supply and installation from initial briefing to after-sales.
testi.Artes nasce a Rende nel 1975 come piccol: Artes was established in Rende, Calabria, in 1975 as an artisanal workshop in textiles and furnishing accessories. Work with interiors soon expanded into furniture making, and in 1985 the company opened its own joinery workshop.
testi.Dal 1988 la falegnameria lavora anche pe: Since 1988 the workshop has also delivered renovations and contract fit-outs — moving beyond single pieces to complete environments delivered to tight specifications and schedules. In 2000 the business became Artes srl and structured a dedicated partner network for metalwork, stone, glass and upholstery.
testi.Oggi seguiamo commesse per uffici, negoz: Today we manage commissions for offices, retail stores, bars and restaurants, food stores and hotels across Calabria and throughout Italy, working to a six-phase method with one dedicated contact per client. Our joinery workshop remains the heart of the business — the place where everything that cannot be bought from a catalogue takes shape.
testi.Cinque tappe che raccontano perché oggi: Five milestones explaining why we manage the entire fit-out rather than simply supplying furniture.
testi.Nasce come piccola impresa artigianale n: Founded as a small artisanal workshop specialising in textiles and furnishing accessories.
testi.L'attività si specializza negli arredame: The company expands into furniture and opens its own joinery workshop: custom pieces made in-house to drawing.
testi.Arrivano le ristrutturazioni e le prime: First renovation and contract commissions, managing every interior package from site survey to installation.
testi.L'azienda diventa Artes srl e struttura: The company incorporates as Artes srl and establishes its specialist partner network for metalwork, stone, glass and upholstery.
testi.Uffici, negozi, bar e ristoranti, negozi: Offices, retail stores, bars and restaurants, food stores and hotels: one consistent method applied across very different environments.
testi.La cura artigianale delle origini e l'or: The craftsmanship of our origins combined with contract discipline: design, production and installation under one single responsibility.
testi.Analisi delle esigenze, sopralluogo e ri: Needs analysis, site survey, design, production and supply, logistics and installation, and after-sales — all coordinated by a single project manager.
testi.Falegnameria interna dal 1985, rete qual: In-house joinery workshop since 1985, supported by a vetted partner network for metalwork, stone, glass and upholstery. No minimum order.
testi.Scuole, biblioteche, uffici pubblici e s: Schools, libraries, public offices and healthcare facilities: accredited on Italy's Electronic Public Procurement Marketplace (MEPA), handling both fit-out and documentation.
testi.Tecnici, progettisti, artigiani e montat: Technicians, designers, craftspeople and fitters: one joined-up team supporting each client from the initial survey through after-sales care.
